newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM in Polish plastic products venture.
newsitem.headline: DSM in Polish plastic products venture.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Tuesday its DSM Engineering Plastic Products unit had agreed to set up a 50-50 joint venture with Kaprolan of Poland for the manufacture and sale of engineering plastic stock shapes.
The 50-50 joint venture, DSM EPP Kaprolan, would be based in Poznan and start trading immediately, DSM said.
It said the joint venture fitted with the strategy of DSM Engineering Plastic Products to bolster its global position in the production and sale of engineering plastic stock shapes.
No financial details of the agreement were disclosed.
DSM said Kaprolan was strongly positioned on the Polish market in cast nylon stock shapes. Under the joint venture it will also start selling DSM plastic products in Poland.
Engineering plastic stock shapes are sheets, rods and tubular bars used for making engineering and other parts.
"From its base in Poznan (western Poland) the new company will also support local customers in the development of new applications and in their choice of materials," DSM added.
DSM Engineering Plastic Products, a wholly-owned subsidiary of DSM, posts annual sales of some 600 million guilders worldwide.
